title: The Toy Robot
text:
Ali has a toy robot. The robot is silver and small. It can walk and it can talk. Ali plays with the robot after school.

His cousin Zeynep comes to visit. They play a game with the robot. Zeynep wins the game. Ali laughs and says, 'Let's play again!'

questions.text: What color is the toy robot?
Why does Ali say, 'Let's play again!'?
options: He had fun playing with Zeynep
He wants to go to sleep

questions.text: What kind of relationship do Ali and Zeynep probably have?

vocabulary.definition: a machine that can move and do tasks
the child of your aunt or uncle
an activity you play for fun

paragraph_translations: Ali'nin oyuncak bir robotu var. Robot gümüş renkli ve küçük. Yürüyebilir ve konuşabilir. Ali okuldan sonra robotla oynar.
Kuzeni Zeynep ziyarete gelir. Robotla bir oyun oynarlar. Zeynep oyunu kazanır. Ali gülerek 'Tekrar oynayalım!' der.
